name: Alice Starwell
source:
Role: Swordsmaiden
Likes: Honor, Justice
Dislikes: Evildoers
Alliance: Crescent

A noble from Crescent, Alice partners with Albert to form Caeruleum. With her refined disposition and unyielding sense of justice, Alice is the temper to Albert's aloofness. She wields the classic longsword in battle.

[From the [url=https://www.blissfulberyl.com/empyrealdawn]official website[/url]]
